spec.name: omp-guards-skip-subagents
spec.intent:
Census @a9258730; re-derive any line cited below if its path changed since. Realize on omp the clause `enforcement scope` gained at 2026-09-30T08:38 (operator ruling 'guards bind main-session personas only'): a guard binds a composing agent only in that agent's own main session, never in a subagent it dispatches. The canon cells and Claude Code are unit guards-skip-subagents.
AT CENSUS. The persona's guard module, generated by packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/render.ts and placed in the persona's scope where only its --config overlay names it, takes its identity from placement (TURN_BRIDGE, render.ts:685-699: scopeName is the persona's directory). omp hands a spawned subagent session its parent's extensions: in the installed omp binary the subagent session options carry `preloadedExtensionPaths: l ? [] : n.extensionPaths` beside `parentAgentId` [inferred from the binary's strings; confirm against a live omp session or omp's own source]. So every tool_call in a subagent of a persona fires the purview guard (tool.use.pre) and the pre-tool stance guard (its acts) against that persona's contract, competing with the main session's guards for the same judge. session_stop does not fire for subagents (packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/events.ts:42-44).
CHANGE. The generated module judges nothing in a subagent session: each registration that asks the judge returns before asking it, and before printing any notice, when omp presents the running session as a subagent, and a main session is judged exactly as today. Establish how omp exposes that to an extension (the handler's ctx, the event, or the process environment) and use that one signal; name it, with where it was read (omp version, binary or source path), in a comment beside it. Keep the adapter's act bindings and its subagent.end channel: a cell may still bind them. Add .changeset/omp-guards-skip-subagents.md (@cratylus/forge patch).
accept: A case in packages/forge/test/adapters/omp.test.ts loads the module ompGuardrailExtensions generates for a persona binding tool.use.pre and subagent.dispatch.pre, against a stub ExtensionAPI and a judge stub that counts calls, and fires one tool_call as omp presents it in a subagent session and one as in a main session: the judge is asked 0 times for the first, which returns no block, and once for the second. Against render.ts at a9258730 the subagent call is judged, so the case fails there.
The generated module names the omp signal it reads for a subagent session, and where that was established, in a comment beside the check; print it.
Green: `pnpm --filter @cratylus/forge exec vitest run test/adapters/omp.test.ts` and `pnpm --filter @cratylus/forge typecheck` exit 0.
